duplication_findings.finding: One ManagerSpec renderer per concept, not one per manager
duplication_findings.detail: Four concepts times thirty-eight managers would be one hundred and fifty-two hand-written screens. Each concept implements renderManager() once; every assigned manager renders through it.
duplication_findings.risk_if_ignored: Semantics drift on the second screen and the four concepts stop being comparable.

duplication_findings.finding: The provider manager is deliberately not shared
duplication_findings.detail: It is the one surface the four designs are supposed to disagree about, so it stays bespoke in every concept while everything else is normalised.
duplication_findings.risk_if_ignored: Sharing it would erase the difference the bakeoff exists to show.

duplication_findings.finding: Status vocabulary is owned by one file
duplication_findings.detail: shared/pm-semantics.js owns the words; the theme owns the paint. Colour is never the only carrier — every status is icon plus word.
duplication_findings.risk_if_ignored: Eight themes times six statuses is where accessibility regressions hide.

duplication_findings.finding: Usage is a boundary card, not a manager
duplication_findings.detail: manager-usage exists in every concept precisely so no concept quietly reimplements Usage inside Settings.
